issue.title: Sanitize Git fixture environments under hooks

implementation.environment: fixtureGitEnvironment removes every inherited GIT_* key through repoGitEnvironment, then installs GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 while retaining ordinary variables.
implementation.command_posture: runFixtureGit prepends -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null and -c core.fsmonitor=false to every fixture Git command; execFixtureGit is its throwing setup wrapper.
implementation.callers: All ordinary temporary-repository initializers under tooling/tests found by the structural census route directly or through a local wrapper to runFixtureGit/execFixtureGit.
implementation.remaining_raw_initializer: tests/tooling/verify/lib/repo-paths.test.ts:53 only; payloadRan deliberately bypasses one or both protections to prove repository fsmonitor and host filter payloads execute in the control arms.

redirects.result: fixture repositories initialize locally and sentinel config/index bytes remain unchanged

controls.config_isolation: tests/tooling/verify/lib/repo-paths.test.ts plants a live host-global attributes/filter command; the positive control executes it and fixtureGitEnvironment blocks it.
controls.fsmonitor: tests/tooling/verify/lib/repo-paths.test.ts plants a live repository core.fsmonitor command; the positive control executes it and FIXTURE_GIT_CONFIG_ARGS blocks it.
controls.hooks: Adversarial /tmp control installed an executable failing pre-commit hook after fixture init; add+commit through execFixtureGit succeeded and the hook sentinel remained absent.
controls.ordinary_env: Existing git-fixture test retains ORB_FIXTURE_ENV_CONTROL; independent /tmp control retained ORB_REVIEW_KEEP while stripping GIT_DIR/GIT_COMMON_DIR.

ast_grep.positive_controls: The raw initializer pattern matched purpose-built TS and TSX controls in /tmp.

notes: An attempted `pnpm exec tsx` could not run because tsx is not installed; it was not treated as evidence. The same /tmp control was then run successfully with Node's TypeScript stripping.
